page.layout: Running head at top centre: "PARS SECVNDA." and page number 241 at top right. Two medallion portraits side by side above the text, each with its legend around the rim (left: Maria; right: Catarina). One column of running text below, with two entries. Signature "Qqq" centred below the text.

main_text.l: MARIA VID. D. G. REG. HVNGARIAE ET BOHEMIAE [?]
CATARINA REG. PORTVG.
MARIA, Philippi Archiducis Austriæ, & Ioannę Reginę
Hispaniarũ filia, & Caroli quinti Imperatoris soror, nupsit ad-
modum puella Ludouico inferioris Pannoniæ Regi, qui in ipso
statim adolescētiæ suæ limine, anno 1527. cum aduersus Tur-
cas infeliciter pugnasset, fuga sibi salutem quærens, in palude
quadã interiit, superincumbentis equi pondere suffocatus. Cu-
ius memoriæ tantũ tribuit Maria, vt nulla vnquam ratione ad-
duci potuerit, vt aut ad secundas nuptias animũ adiiceret, aut
vestẽ lugubrẽ cultu amœniore mutaret. Nec multò post à Ca-
rolo fratre inferioris Germaniæ gubernaculis admota, strenuè
imprimis munus sibi creditũ obiuit: multáque Cæsare absente
bella Gallis, Sicābris, & Menapiis partim vltro intulit, partim ab
illis illata sustinuit. In omni denique vitæ ratione virilē potius,
quàm muliebrē animũ præ se tulit, à principũ mulierũ deli-
ciis prorsus abhorres. Tādē vt nominis sui memoriæ cõsuleret,
in Eburonũ, & Namurcēsiũ finibus oppidũ egregiè munitũ
cõdidit, quod de nomine suo Mariæ Burgum voluit appellatum.
CATHARINA, quarta Philippi Archiducis Austriæ fi-
lia, nupsit Ioanni Emanuelis Lusitaniæ Regis filio, qui hodie re-
gni eius sceptra tenet, quem & quatuor liberorum Emanuelis,
Philippi, Mariæ, & Isabellæ parētem fecit. Hæc præter insignem
formæ venustatem, eruditionis nomine in primis commēdatur
aliis etiam virtutibus, regia matrona dignis, egregiè dotata.

page.notes: Medallion legends are transcribed from the rim; the left legend's reading order (ET BOHEMIAE / MARIA VID. D. G. REG. / HVNGARIAE) is partly uncertain at the edge of the coin. Printed "Ioannę" and "Tādē" kept as printed. Medallion legends are set in capitals; the first is marked [?]. No catchword is printed.
